text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Greymon] in name or w/[CS] trait: Cost 3

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: {Hand} [Main] If you have [Nokia Shiramine], 1 of your [Agumon] digivolves into this card for a digivolution cost of 6, ignoring digivolution requirements. [When Digivolving] Activate 1 of the effects below: ・1 of your [Gabumon] may digivolve into [MetalGarurumon] in the hand, ignoring digivolution requirements and without paying the cost. ・Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Omnimon] in its name, trash your opponent's top security card.
